findings.finding: All write modes use direct write_text/write_bytes to the authoritative runtime path. A process or disk failure after truncation can leave a partial generated document; no temp-file/fsync/replace boundary is present in the fixed sources.
findings.next_action: If crash-safe regeneration is required, add an atomic writer and a dedicated failure-injection test; do not call this a reproduced corruption bug.

findings.finding: load_raw_monster_db directly imports build_complete_monster_client_art.py, while source authority/routing is represented by hardcoded constants. This supplement did not prove that source_priority_policy is consulted before this route.
findings.evidence: fixed source body; no generator execution
findings.next_action: Bind the builder to the approved source-priority receipt before treating routed-source exhaustion as verified.

findings.finding: Entity registry hashes raw bytes, while affix and ground builders normalize CRLF before hashing. This is deterministic per tool but can produce different identity semantics for equivalent line endings.
findings.next_action: Document or unify hash normalization only if cross-tool source hash comparison is an acceptance contract.

findings.finding: build() always reads and validates equipment_granted_skills.source.json even when that lane is not in policy.sources. A missing/unusable optional lane therefore blocks the entire registry build; this is source-dependent behavior, not a reproduced failure here.
findings.next_action: Confirm the file is a mandatory registry dependency; otherwise gate it by declared policy lane with an explicit contract.

findings.finding: Schema, ID, contract, probability and CLI exclusivity checks use assert. Python -O would remove these checks before a write. No optimized invocation was run.
findings.next_action: Use explicit exceptions for production generator validation if optimized execution is possible.

findings.finding: The output records classification_count but no classification source hash; source_sha covers only the slot policy source. A classification mapping change with unchanged count is not detectable from this output alone.
findings.next_action: Add classification hash only if runtime provenance requires detecting classification content drift.
